name: Taq-based polymerase chain reaction
summary: By 1989 immunologists were using PCR with a heat-tolerant enzyme to copy chosen stretches of DNA millions of times, making tiny genetic samples usable in research.
description: Repeated primer-directed thermal DNA amplification using thermostable Taq DNA polymerase.
tier_reason: The general Taq-based amplification method supports research, diagnosis and later sequencing workflows; the 1989 application is a witness, not its invention.
why: A newly available, easily automated amplification method let immunology laboratories study genes from very small samples.
